title: Finding Record
description: Stage 12 output. One per FAILED disposition. Root cause must be evidence-supported or explicitly marked suspected/undetermined — never asserted without support (Constitution §2).

component.description: Real file/module path — required for Diagnostic Index lookup.

error_signatures_verbatim.description: Exact exception types, log strings, HTTP error bodies observed — this is what a future production incident search will match against.

assumptions_relied_on.description: What was assumed true about this component that turned out false, or that testing relied on (Constitution §5 / diagnostic traceability).

root_cause.description: Required if root_cause_status is DETERMINED or SUSPECTED.

accepted_by.description: Required if status is ACCEPTED_RISK — per LIFECYCLE.md this must name the human, never QA itself.
